title.value:
IGLUE: A Benchmark for Transfer Learning
across Modalities, Tasks, and Languages
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
IGLUE: A Benchmark for Transfer Learning
across Modalities, Tasks, and Languages

extractions.description: The paper introduces IGLUE, a new benchmark for multilingual multimodal models, focusing on vision-and-language tasks across 20 diverse languages. It includes visual question answering, cross-modal retrieval, grounded reasoning, and grounded entailment tasks, designed to evaluate transfer learning in zero-shot and few-shot settings.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is about creating a benchmark for evaluating multilingual multimodal models. While it enables research in areas that can be applied to sustainable development, the paper itself doesn't have sustainable development as a central theme.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote:
In order to incentivise and guide future research in multi-
lingual V&L research, we introduce the Image-Grounded
Language Understanding Evaluation (IGLUE) benchmark.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly address any of the listed Sustainable Development categories. It provides a tool (benchmark) that can be used in various fields, including those related to sustainable development, but it is not directly focused on any specific category.
primary_category.quote:
We introduce the Image-Grounded
Language Understanding
Evaluation benchmark. IGLUE brings together—
by both aggregating pre-existing datasets and
creating new ones—visual question answering,
cross-modal retrieval, grounded reasoning, and
grounded entailment tasks across 20 diverse lan-
guages.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper doesn't directly fall into any of the listed sub-categories. It's a general machine learning benchmark.
primary_sub_category.quote:
We create IGLUE by collating current research threads in
this area and extending them with two datasets for cross-
lingual visual entailment (XVNLI) and image–text retrieval
(xFlickr&CO), for an even more comprehensive coverage of
tasks.

new_primary_category.justification: There is no new primary category.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no new primary subcategory.
